name: com.oauth.onesdkbranch.view.tips.oneSDKBranchTipsView
description: The CIB SDK OneSDK Branch shows a follow-up prompt for guest sign-in, clearing an account, or changing a nickname. Confirming continues the selected account action, and account clearing has a short countdown.
disableEffect: Users cannot complete these follow-up account actions, including guest sign-in and account clearing.
